entities.summary: Artem Sytnyk is a Ukrainian lawyer, former prosecutor's investigator, first director of the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine. (2015-2022), former deputy head of the National Agency on Corruption Prevention, deputy director of Ukraine's Defence Procurement Agency (DPA).
